 One Piece Chapter 1197 Release Date, Time & Where to Read
 Ritika Singh 2026년 10월 29일 목 오전 4:59 UTC 0 Photo Credit: Crunchyroll Curious about the One Piece Chapter 1197 release date? In the previous chapter, fans saw Sanji finally overcome his weakness. Thus, they are eagerly waiting for the next chapter.
 When is the One Piece Chapter 1197 release date and time?
 One Piece Chapter 1197 is expected to be released globally on November 1, 2026, at 10 AM ET. 
 Below are the release times for Chapter 1197 in major regions:
 7 AM PT
 9 AM CT
 10 AM ET
 Moreover, readers in Japan can access the upcoming chapter on Monday, November 2, 2026, at 12 AM JST.
 Where to read the One Piece Manga with Chapter 1197?
 Fans can read the One Piece Manga with Chapter 1197 on platforms such as Shueisha’s MANGA Plus, Viz Media, and Shonen Jump+.
 Advertisement
 MANGA Plus offers translated versions of chapters of manga running in Weekly Shonen Jump.
 Fans can also read the upcoming chapter on Viz Media. It provides the first three chapters and the new chapters of a manga with English translations for free.
 Readers can also read the next chapter on Shonen Jump+.
 In Chapter 1196, Sanji tried to kill Saint Killingham with his kicks. As such, Killingham decides to attack Sanji with Ivankov. The Holy Knight ends up fusing with Ivankov and transforms into a being with Ivankov’s head and Kirin’s body. A flashback is shown of Sanji used to live in the Kamabakka Kingdom. Sanji recalls that Ivankov told him that he lacked self-love. The flashback ends, and Sanji realizes something.
 It is revealed that Sanji’s biggest weakness is that he doesn’t love himself. He realizes that being a Straw Hat helps him overcome his weakness, and Ivankov finally vanishes from his thoughts. The chapter concludes with Sanji lighting his cigarette as he prepares to fight Killingham again.
